tokens.transfer_statement: Cloudflare is based in the United States. Where data reaches it from the EU or UK, the transfer is governed by EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) under its Data Processing Agreement. This is the standard safeguard for transfers to the US after the Schrems II ruling.

_features_note: This site is the parent landing page: no contact form (the footer mailto is the only route in), no analytics script, no embeds. payments is a link out to a Stripe payment page on /support; no Stripe script loads here.
_payment_record_retention_note: Set to 7 years by the owner on 2026-10-05. Change it only on a decision, then re-render.

processors.name: Cloudflare, Inc.
processors.note: Contacted as the host, never as a browser request to a Cloudflare domain. No hosts to scan for; leaving `hosts` empty tells the auditor not to expect one.

_allowedHosts_note: Hosts a visitor only reaches by clicking a link. An outbound link is not a data transfer, so these need no disclosure. Anything the browser fetches automatically belongs in `processors` instead.
